content: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria
Noqw ima Pharisee‐sinom nanaptaqw, yaw Jesus John epnihqe wūhaqnihqamuy sinotak̇aṅw, pumuy kūyit akw tuvoylalawu.
Pay as pi Jesus qa nāp sinmuy kūyit akw tuvoylalawu, pay put aw nánatuwnayaqam pantsatsk̇a.
Noqw yaw pumuy yan nanaptaqat Jesus navotqe, Judea‐tutskwat mātapt, pu Galilee‐tutskwat aqw’a.
Noqw pas pam kurs hin qa Samaria‐tutskwat aṅni.
Nihqe ōviy pam Samariat ep kitsókit Sycar yan mātsiwhqat aw pitu, ura Jacob tiy Joseph hihsaq tutskwat máqahqat áhayhpnihqat aw’i.
Noqw Jacob nöṅanvatñiat pep’e. Noqw Jesus waynumqe māṅuiwk̇aṅw, patñive qatuptu tāwanasavehaqamo (tāwa navaysikishaqam aṅhqe qöniwmaq’ö)
Noqw hak Samariat ep wuhti kuytoqe ep pitu, noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Okiw nuy kuynaa.
(Put aw nánatuwnayaqam kīmihaqami tunöstuiwisa.)

Noqw pahsat pu Samariat ep wuhti put aw paṅqawu: Ya hintaqw ōviy um Jew‐sinonik̇aṅw inumi kuyhtuviṅlawu, susmataqpi nuy Samariat ep wuhtiniqö’? Ima Jew‐sinom pi Samariat‐sinmuy amumum qa hintsatsk̇aqw ōviy’o.
Noqw Jesus lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: As um God kuwahtipuyat mātsi’te’, pu hak ūmi kuyhtuviṅtaqat hákiynihqat tuwi’tani. Nen um put aw tūviṅtaqw, soon pam uṅ kūyit taytaqat qa máqani.
Noqw wuhti put aw paṅqawu: Meh, tāqa, noqw pi um hihta akw kuyniqey ṅastaa, noqw patñi hinurs hötsi. Noqw um put kūyit taytaqat háqamnihqe ōviy’o?
Ya um itanay Jacob epnihqe hak pas pávani? Pam pi ura itamuy pay hísathaqam it patñit maqa; nihqe ura nāp put aṅqw hīhiko, pu tímatu, pu pokmatu.
Jesus lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: It pāhut aṅqw hikwqa pay piw pānaqmokmantani.
Nīk̇aṅw ason nu’ hakiy kūyit maqaqw, put aṅqw hikwqa soon hisat pānaqmokni; noqw nu’ hakiy kūyit maqaqw, pam kūyi hakiy ahsonve pāhut yamamataqat antani, nen qatsit qaso’taqat aaniwnani.
Noqw wuhti put aw paṅqawu: Meh, tāqa, himu as um nuy it kūyit maqaqw, nu pāpu qa pānaqmokni, piw qa aṅqw kuytomantani.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Yupa uhpuwsuṅway wiktoo, noqw uma aṅqwni.
Noqw wuhti lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Nu ṅasta puwsuṅway’ta. Noqw Jesus aw paṅqawu: Pas um súaṅqawhqe Nu ṅasta puwsuṅway’ta, kita.
Pi um as tsívotnihqamuy puwsuṅwta; noqw i’ pu’ umum qátuhqa pay qa uhpuwsuṅwa. Um paṅqawhqe súaṅqawu.
Noqw wuhti put aw paṅqawu: Meh tāqa, kurs um hak God lavay’ayaata.
Noqw itanam pi it tūkwit ep God aw nānawakna; noqw úmuyniqw pi as sinom soon qa Jerusalem ep God aw nānawaknani.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Wuhti, um nuy tuptsiwni, pay nāt uma qa it tūkwit, piw qa Jerusalem ep Inay aw nānawaknaniqat aw pituto.
Uma hihta aw nānawaknaqey haknihqat qa navoti’yuṅwa; itam pi hakiy aw nānawaknaqey navoti’yuṅwa, pi God Jew‐sinmuy amuhpiy sinmuy ayo ōoyaqw ōviy’o.

Nīk̇aṅw pay nāt aw pituto, híkispi pas aw pitsíwta, pep pu’ hakim aṅ pas antsa Inay aw nāwakinwisqam unaṅway aṅqw pas antsay’k̇ahk̇aṅw put aw nāwakinwisniqat aw’i. Pi pan hapi hakim Inay aw nāwakinwisnihqamuy pam tuṅlay’ta.
Pi God hapi Hikwsi; noqw put aw nāwakinwisqam pas soon qa unaṅway aṅqw pas antsay’k̇ahk̇aṅw put aw nāwakinwisni.
Noqw wuhti put aw paṅqawu: Antsa yaw hak Messias Christ yan túṅwantiwhqa God aṅqw pítuniqat nu navoti’ta; ason yaw pam hak pite’, itamuy sohsok hihta āawnani.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pay nu ūmi yuaataqa hapi pam Messias.
Noqw pahsat pu put aw nánatuwnayaqam ö́kihqe, pam wuhtit amum yuaataqw aw k̇āwuwaya; noqw qa haqawa put hihta tūviṅtaqat, pu sen pam hinoqw put aw yuaataqat put tūviṅta.
Noqw pahsat pu wuhti wikoroy pep mātapt, kīminihqe, ep sinmuy amumi paṅqawu:
Kurs huvam inumum pāmiye’, it hakiy tāqat nuy aṅqaqw hihta hinhtiqat sohsok nuy āawnaqat aw uma yórikyani; ya sen qa i’ hak Christ?
Pahsat pu puma kīṅaqw nö́ṅakqe, put aw öki.
Noqw put ahkwayñap Jesus aw nánatuwnayaqam put aw ö’qalyaqe paṅqaqwa: Nȫsaa, Tutuqaynaqa.
Noqw pam umumi paṅqawu: Pay nu nōvat nösniqey himuy’taqw, uma put qa tuwi’yuṅwa.
Noqw ōviy put aw nánatuwnayaqam nānami paṅqaqwa: Ya sen pay hak eṅem nōvay’va?
Noqw Jesus amumi paṅqawu: Nu hakiy nuy aṅqw távihqat tunatyayat hintsak̇e’, put tumalayat yúkiniqw pam pantaqa inuṅem nȫsiwhqat anta.

Noqw ya uma qa paṅqaqwa: Pay nāt nālöq mūmuyawhtuy ep pu’ natwani tsovalniwni, kitota? Meh, nu umumi paṅqawni: Kurs huvam kwuhpukye’, pāvasat aṅ yórikyaa; pi pay tukwsiwyuṅqe tsovalniwniqat aw pitsíwta.
Noqw hö́hökqa ahsalawṅwu, nihqe soñawnen sinmuy tsovalaqw, puma qatsit qa so’taqat himuy’vayani. Noqw uyhqaniqw, pu hökqa puma nāma hahlayhtiṅwu.
Noqw yep hapi yan yuaatiwhqa pas antsaa: Suhk̇a uyhq, pu suhk̇a hȫqö, ii.
Uma haqe’ qa maqsontotat aṅ höqyaniqat nu aw umuy ayata. Pay pētu aṅ tumaltotaqw, uma amumum sumitumalay’yuṅwni.
Noqw k̇aysiwhqam Samariat ep sinom pep kīve yesqam wuhtit lavayiyat ahpiy Jesus aw tūtuptsiwa, ura pam paṅqawu: Pas nu aṅqaqw hihta hinhtiqat pam nuy sohsok āawna.
Noqw ōviy Samariat ep sinom Jesus aw ö́kihqe, pam pumuy amumum huruhtiniqat put aw nānawakna; noqw pam lȫs tāwat aṅ pep qatu.
Noqw piw nāt pētu k̇aysiwhqam pas nāp lavayiyat ahpiy put aw tūtuptsiwa;
Nihqe wuhtit aw paṅqawu: Pu’ hapi itam tūtuptsiwa, qa uhlavayiy ahpiy’o, pi itam pas nāp aw tūqayyuṅqe, pas suyan i’ hak sinmuy ayo ōoyhqa Christnihqat itam nanapta.
Jesus Heals an Official’s Son
Noqw ahpiy lȫs talq pam paṅqw ahpiynihqe, Galileet aqw’a.
Pi God lavay’ayaat nāp tutskway ep qa k̇aptsiwtaṅwuqat Jesus nāp paṅqawu.
Noqw pam Galilee‐tutskwat ep pituqw, Galilee‐sinom put pās taviya, puma pi nuhtum Jerusalem ep nōviwhqat épeqyaqe, put hihta hinhtiqat sohsok aw yórikyaqe ōviy’o.
Noqw Jesus Galileet ep Canat aw piw pitu; pep ura pam kūyit aṅqw ovavalat yuku. Noqw hak pas pavan sinot tiat tiyo Capernaum ep tūtuya.
Noqw yaw Jesus Judeat aṅqw Galileet ep pítuhqat naat navota; noqw pam as put ámumnen tiyotiyat qalaptsinaniqat pam aw nāwakna, pam okiw mokíwuy aqw pitsíwtaqw ōviy’o.
Pahsat pu Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pas uma aṅ k̇ātatayhpit hihta tuawi’yuṅqat aw qa yórike’ soon tūtuptiwani.
Noqw pas pavan tāqa put aw paṅqawu: Tāqa, um okiw itiy nāt qa mokq aqwni.
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pay um aqwni, pay uhti qatu. Noqw Jesus put aw hin lavayhtiqat tāqa tuptsiwhqe, paṅqw ahpiy’o.
Nihqe ōviy pam pahsat atk̇amiqniqw, tumal’aymat ahsawvayaqe āawnayaqe aw paṅqaqwa: Pay uhti qa mokqe qatu.
Pahsat pu pam hísatniqw aṅqwtiqat pam pumuy tūviṅta; noqw puma paṅqaqwa: Tāvok tāwanasaproyaqw (tāwa aṅhqe tsaṅe’sikis qöniwmaqw) pam mukihoya.
Noqw naat navoti’taqw, ura pahsat Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pay uhti qatu, kita. Nihqe ōviy pam nāp tuptsiwa, pu kīyat sohsoyam ep yesqamu.
Noqw Jesus Judeat aṅqw Galileet ep pitut yan k̇ātatyhpit tumaltaqe pas hímunihqey pahsat lȫs namtakna.
